ce_bugs.text: app/models/post.rb:132 — RSS content is stored as raw HTML and then rendered without sanitization, so a compromised feed can persist script execution for forum visitors.
lib/topic_retriever.rb:27 — A worker failure between SETNX and EXPIRE leaves a permanent throttle key that silently prevents normal retrieval of that URL.
app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:12 — With retries disabled, any transient fetch or malformed item exception aborts the poll and silently skips all remaining feed updates until the next schedule.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:15 — Concurrent retrieval and feed imports can both pass the existence check, causing the loser to raise on the unique index and abort its remaining feed work.
app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 — Calling String#scrub makes feed polling crash on the supported Ruby 1.9/2.0 runtimes where that method does not exist.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:64 — Bare and parent-directory relative links are left relative, so imported content resolves them against the Discourse embed page instead of its source article.
lib/tasks/disqus.thor:142 — The new TopicEmbed import path drops the thread created_at that the previous PostCreator call supplied, timestamping every imported Disqus topic at import time.
lib/topic_retriever.rb:27 — A process failure between SETNX and EXPIRE leaves the retrieval throttle key without a TTL, permanently suppressing future imports for that URL.
db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb:3 — force: true` drops any pre-existing `topic_embeds` table and its data when this migration runs.
db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:3 — Adding `force: true` makes this historical migration drop an existing `top_topics` table instead of failing safely.
lib/topic_retriever.rb:41 — Each cache-miss retrieval runs the full feed import, so many distinct embed URLs can repeatedly parse and process every feed item.
lib/topic_retriever.rb:27 — A process crash after SETNX but before EXPIRE leaves the retrieval throttle key permanent, preventing all future imports for that URL.
app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — Remote article fetching has no open/read timeout, so an unresponsive embed host can indefinitely occupy a retrieval worker.
app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29 — Feed downloading and parsing have no timeout, allowing one stalled configured feed to hold a scheduled job worker indefinitely.
lib/topic_retriever.rb:15 — The public embed URL check matches only the hostname, so callers can make the server fetch non-HTTP schemes or arbitrary ports on the configured host via open(url).

mrv_findings.text: [75][P1] app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — `Readability::Document.new(open(url).read,` — `import_remote` is reached through `RetrieveTopic` without requiring `open-uri`, so the independent embed-retrieval job treats an HTTP URL as a local filename and fails instead of fetching it.

[75][P1] lib/topic_retriever.rb:41 — `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` — this path references `Jobs::PollFeed` without loading `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, so feed-enabled retrieval can raise `uninitialized constant Jobs::PollFeed`.

[100][P1] app/models/topic_embed.rb:64 — `if href.present? && href.start_with?('/')` — only root-relative URLs are rewritten despite the relative-URL promise, so path-relative article links and images resolve against the Discourse iframe origin and break.

[100][P2] app/views/embed/loading.html.erb:7 — `setTimeout(function() { document.location.reload(); }, 30000);` — no retrieval-failure or timeout state exists, so a permanently unavailable remote import leaves the embed in an infinite refresh loop.

[100][P1] db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb:4 — `t.integer :topic_id, null: false` / `t.integer :post_id, null: false` — independent non-FK IDs permit an embed topic to differ from its updated post, representing a broken relationship.

[100][P1] lib/topic_retriever.rb:41 — `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` — every cache-miss retrieval synchronously downloads and imports the entire feed before fetching one URL, creating an unbounded O(requests × feed-items) worker hot path.

[100][P1] app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — `Readability::Document.new(open(url).read,` — remote documents are fully materialized with no timeout or size bound, so a slow or oversized allowed-host page can exhaust retrieval workers.

[100][P2] app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:31 — `rss.items.each do |i|` / `TopicEmbed.import(user, url, i.title, content)` — hourly polling materializes and reprocesses every feed item with per-item database work and no cursor or limit.

[75][P2] lib/topic_retriever.rb:26 — `if $redis.setnx(retrieved_key, "1")` / `$redis.expire(retrieved_key, 60)` — a crash between the non-atomic Redis calls leaves a throttle key without TTL, blocking non-staff retrieval indefinitely.

[75][P2] app/models/topic_embed.rb:35 — `revisor.revise!(...)` / `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)` — the content hash advances without confirming persistence, so later polls can suppress repair of a failed update.

[75][P2] app/models/topic_embed.rb:15 — `embed = TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first` / `TopicEmbed.create!(...)` — concurrent retrievers can both create topic/post work before the unique-index failure aborts the feed pass.

[75][P1] lib/tasks/disqus.thor:148 — `post = TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])` — replacing the established import path silently drops documented `--category` placement and thread `created_at` preservation without acceptance evidence.

[100][P1] app/models/topic_embed.rb:22 — `PostCreator.new(user, title: title, raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents), skip_validations: true, cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html])` — attacker-controlled RSS HTML bypasses sanitization and is persisted as cooked HTML, enabling stored XSS.

[75][P1] lib/topic_retriever.rb:15 — `SiteSetting.embeddable_host != URI(@embed_url).host` / app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 `open(url).read` — redirect destinations are not revalidated, so an allowed-host open redirect can fetch internal or metadata endpoints (SSRF).

[100][P3] app/assets/javascripts/embed.js:17 — `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }` — prefix matching trusts attacker-controlled lookalike origins, allowing forged resize messages to manipulate iframe layout.

[100][P1] spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:43 — `TopicRetriever.expects(:new).returns(retriever)` — the test asserts an obsolete synchronous retriever while the controller queues `Jobs.enqueue`, so it neither validates enqueue payload/loading response nor can pass against the implementation.

[100][P2] spec/components/topic_retriever_spec.rb:33 — `topic_retriever.expects(:perform_retrieve).once` — mocking the retrieval implementation leaves Redis throttling, existing-embed, feed fallback, and HTTP-import branches unexercised.

[100][P2] spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb:35 — `poller.expects(:poll_feed).once` — all poller tests mock `poll_feed`, leaving new RSS parsing, URL fallback, content conversion, and import behavior untested.

[100][P1] db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:3 — `create_table :top_topics, force: true do |t|` — replay drops any existing table before recreation, silently destroying ranking data with no recovery path.

[75][P1] db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb:4 — `t.integer :topic_id, null: false` / `t.integer :post_id, null: false` — missing foreign keys permit orphaned embed rows after topic or post deletion.
